- `abstract protected Animal createOffspring(Field field, Location loc)` — factory hook so the template can instantiate the right species

- `abstract protected int getBreedingAge()` / `getBreedingProbability()` / `getMaxLitterSize()` — constants surfaced as polymorphic getters so the template can call them
- `abstract protected Animal createOffspring(Field field, Location loc)` — factory hook so the template can instantiate the right species
- `protected void spawnOffspring(List<Animal>)` — the single implementation of the 10-line breed-and-spawn loop that was duplicated in every subclass

**Each of Ant, Dingo, Eagle, Emu, Rat, Snake:**
- 4 one-liner overrides expose the species constants and factory
- The 10-line breeding block in `act()` collapses to `spawnOffspring(newX)`

Each `act()` body is now just 4 lines inside the active-time guard: `spreadDisease`, `spawnOffspring`, `moveOrDie` — the structure is readable at a glance and the breeding logic lives in one place.
